categories.main_business_segments: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings primarily operates in two main business segments: container shipping and terminal operations. The container shipping segment includes international and domestic container transportation services managed through subsidiaries such as COSCO SHIPPING Lines and OOIL. The terminal business segment involves container and bulk cargo handling through COSCO SHIPPING Ports, which operates a global network of terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced shipping technologies including eco-friendly and methanol dual-fuel container vessels, digital supply chain platforms, blockchain-based green shipping certificates, and intelligent warehousing and customer service systems. It emphasizes green and low-carbon technologies such as biofuel refueling, shore power for vessels, and energy efficiency management platforms at ports. Digital transformation and AI-driven tools are integral to its supply chain and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings serves global customers involved in international trade, including industries such as automotive, home appliances, cross-border e-commerce, photovoltaic, and lithium batteries. Its major markets include global trade lanes like Trans-Pacific, Asia-Europe, Intra-Asia, Mainland China, and other international regions. The company also targets emerging markets, regional markets, and third-country markets to expand its footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a presence in approximately 145 countries and regions. Key geographic segments include Mainland China, Asia Pacific, Europe, America (including Trans-Pacific routes), South America, Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. It manages terminals and shipping routes across major global ports and trade corridors, including significant investments in ports in China, Europe, the Middle East, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the maritime supply chain. It controls container shipping operations (midstream) and terminal operations (downstream), and extends services into integrated digital supply chain solutions, including logistics and freight forwarding, thereby covering a broad spectrum of the supply chain from transportation to port handling and logistics services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on digital supply chain innovation, green and low-carbon transition, and global network expansion. It invests in R&D for green technologies such as methanol dual-fuel vessels and biofuels, digital platforms including blockchain for green certificates, AI-powered customer service, and intelligent container management. The company also emphasizes developing integrated full-chain products and enhancing smart port capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings generates revenue primarily through container shipping services and terminal operations. Revenue streams include freight charges, supply chain services beyond shipping fees, terminal handling fees, and related logistics services. The company also earns income from investments, equity interests in joint ventures and associates, and financial services related to shipping and logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings is a tier-one global container shipping and terminal operator with significant scale advantages. It competes with other major global shipping alliances and terminal operators. The company maintains a leading position through its large fleet capacity, extensive global network, alliance partnerships (notably the Ocean Alliance), and integrated digital and green initiatives, positioning itself as a world-class digital supply chain enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of RMB 233.86 billion, a 33.29% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB 49.17 billion, more than doubling from the previous year. The company operates a fleet exceeding 3.3 million TEUs capacity and manages terminals with an annual handling capacity of approximately 124 million TEUs. It has a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB 497.47 billion and a decreasing gearing ratio of 42.7%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings differentiates itself by offering integrated global digital supply chain solutions anchored in container shipping and terminal operations. It emphasizes customer-centric services, high-quality and stable shipping routes, innovative green and low-carbon technologies, and advanced digital platforms including blockchain and AI. Its dual-brand strategy and alliance partnerships enhance network coverage and service frequency, providing comprehensive and efficient logistics solutions worldwide.
